attempt_dispositions: NGLView3.0.3 fails actual HTML export with ipywidgets8;3.0.4 and4.0.1 pass the relevant Python/display/HTML probes. No browser rendering acceptance is inferred.

The initial coordinate-test run fails on a global NGLModel count assumption; the coordinate guard now selects the requested model identity. A separate fresh synthetic two-widget probe proves unrelated initial PDB export, which #631 directly repairs and guards.
The #630 strict warning counterexample exits1 on supported3.0.4; all95 selected cases pass after the boundary fix, and the unrecognized-keyword warnings disappear.

Pre-theme #631 receiving passes103 cases per profile; review then demonstrates a required unsynchronized theme resource. The final exporter includes the requested view theme, and both complete profiles pass104 cases including nine dedicated HTML guards and one actual doctest, with no omissions.

Private resource hooks match3.0.4/4.0.1. Required public embedding APIs exist in the official ipywidgets7.0.0 wheel, source-inspected only; runtime profiles use8.x. No higher transitive minimum is invented.

Final profiles retain visible LegacyH5MSM warnings (61 minimum,60 newer). The ordinary current SMonitor bridge is enabled; only the public SMonitor0.16 minimum uses the preexisting documented bridge exception.
limits: Finite Linux source receiving with actual provider sources; not clean installed MolSysMT or every supported platform/interpreter.
Current NGLView Conda artifact identity and selected installed file hashes are verified; the current full Conda archive was not rehashed in this runner.
Only the requested widget and its referenced/shared required resources are exported. The shared color registry and explicitly requested theme are resources, not arbitrary-data isolation guarantees.
No unrelated trajectory-buffer exposure was demonstrated; the old defect proves initial structure/PDB and synchronized message state inclusion.
Frontend/human/Qt/session/browser acceptance remains distinct. No new candidate, tag, Release or CI workflow is selected.
No environment was created, overwritten or downgraded and no native backend was rebuilt.
